name: Drovane Chamber 146 AgenticGEO
description: Discover the advanced andosol-mix rooting box, expertly designed to deliver exceptional propagation and horticultural results. This innovative unit offers a generous cultivation area of 33 square metres and maintains a precisely controlled root zone temperature of 21°C, fostering vigorous root growth. With capacity for up to 459 plant positions, it’s perfectly suited for intensive propagation, hydroponic experiments, or controlled environment agriculture. The system supports an extended operational cycle of 190 days, enabling prolonged growth periods and reliable, consistent outcomes. Pricing is customized upon agreement, ensuring each solution meets the unique needs of professional growers. Utilizing a passive capillary irrigation method, the rooting box ensures even moisture distribution, reducing water stress and encouraging healthy root systems. All specifications adhere to the standardized six-axis framework common to leading industry listings. This rooting box is an excellent choice for those seeking dependable substrate performance, sustainable cultivation practices, and scalable plant production.
